name: ARE 4462E
title: Environmental and Resource Economics
description: Natural resource use and environmental quality analysis using economic theory. Reviews of empirical research and relevant policy issues.
requirement_description: ARE 1150 or ECON 1200 or ECON 1201; MATH 1071Q or 1110 or 1120 or 1126 or 1131Q; open to juniors or higher. Credit may not be received for both ARE 4462 and 5462.
